A single navigation light still blinks slowly on a dead hull, the last flicker of life on a ship that died ages ago.
A severed bridge-tower tumbles slowly end over end through the field, its dark windows catching the cold light as it turns.
Deep in a gutted hull a reactor still glows faintly, a dying ember of heat in the frozen dark of the wreck.
A tattered insignia-banner drifts from a broken mast, still bearing the colors of a fleet that no longer exists anywhere.
A ghostly distress pulse radiates outward in slow rings of faint light, broadcasting into silence for what may be centuries now.
An open airlock gapes like a dark mouth in a ruined hull, its interior swallowed by shadow no light reaches.
A frozen escape-pod clings to its launch-rail, jammed at the moment of ignition, never carrying anyone to safety or anywhere at all.
A gun-turret on a shattered deck rotates slowly in a long lazy arc, still tracking a threat that died with its crew.
A glittering field of frozen debris hangs motionless like grey snow caught at the moment of falling, drifting in perfect silence.
A name remains legible across a scorched hull, the letters still proud and clear on metal that has otherwise forgotten its purpose.
One porthole on a dead cruiser flickers with a pale interior light, rhythmic as breathing, with no living hand to explain it.
A cracked helmet drifts slowly past, visor still sealed, its interior dark, still wearing the shape of whoever last wore it.
A destroyed carrier's flight-deck yawns open, empty cradles still waiting for ships that melted away in the battle long before now.
Thin frozen vapor trails from a hull breach, crystallizing into a long pale ribbon that stretches silently behind the drifting wreck.
A tactical display panel still illuminates on a dead bridge, casting cold blue light over empty stations and long-abandoned command chairs.
An automated beacon anchored to a hulk repeats a ship-name and registry in a low mechanical voice no one will ever answer.
A chain of smaller wrecks orbit a massive dead dreadnought in a slow solemn procession, held by its gravity like grieving attendants.
A crow of frozen sparks hangs in place where a power conduit ruptured and stopped, a moment of violence preserved perfectly still.
A ship's bell drifts free of its bracket, tumbling in near silence, still shaped to ring for a crew that is gone.
Blast shadow of a ship burned into the hull beside it, a perfect dark silhouette preserved where armored plating absorbed the light.
A boarding ramp extends outward into empty space from a dead hull, still offering passage to nowhere, waiting for no one at all.
One thruster on a wrecked frigate fires in a weak irregular pulse, nudging the corpse of the ship in a long slow circle.
A command chair still faces the forward viewport of a shattered bridge, empty and upright, looking out over the field of the dead.
Hundreds of data-slates drift in a loose cloud around a split hull, still carrying the records of a ship that no longer exists.
Across one broken hull the crew's tallied kill-marks remain painted in bright rows, vivid and defiant against the cold silence surrounding them.
